info.name: Parking Availability API
info.description: Flask + MongoDB REST API for smart-city parking availability. Run `python seed.py` first. Run the collection in order with the Collection Runner. Admin: admin@parking.com / Admin@12345. User: user@parking.com / User@12345.

request.description: Log in as the seeded administrator. Stores adminToken.
Log in as the seeded demo driver. Stores userToken and userId.
Register a new user account (role is always 'user').
Validation errors return 400 with a details list.
Return the profile of the logged-in user.
Admin creates a parking lot. occupancy_rate, status and recent_update are calculated automatically.

exec: pm.test("Calculated fields", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("free"); pm.expect(j.vacant_space).to.eql(50); });

request.description: Alternate admin route for creating a parking.
Update parking fields; status is recomputed (limited at 80%+ occupancy).
Admin route for updating a parking.
Update live occupancy and log a history reading.
Admin view of all parking information (includes reviews).

exec: pm.test("Has pagination", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.results.length).to.be.at.most(5); pm.expect(j.total).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Parkings with free spaces; supports min_vacant, max_rate, feature, area filters.
Parkings within radius_km of a coordinate, sorted by distance (Haversine).

exec: pm.test("Sorted by distance", function () { var r = pm.response.json().results; for (var i = 1; i < r.length; i++) { pm.expect(r[i].distance_km).to.be.at.least(r[i-1].distance_km); } });

request.description: Occupancy readings for the last N hours.
Aggregated occupancy statistics by area and status. Requires login.
Public list of reviews with average rating.
Search by area, name or address.
No parkings in that location returns 404.
Availability alerts for saved locations (level: low / full / available).
Users can only view their own alerts.
Nearest available parkings to a destination with Google Maps directions links.
Average occupancy per hour of day using aggregation on history.
Admin deletes parking and its history.
